scope: Local feasibility experiment; NOT shipped to the watch.
pca_window: candidate start minus 8 through current completion; max 74 samples
gate_location: before confirmation; rejected evidence resets the run; three consecutive accepted cycles required
tuning: Thresholds chosen after inspecting real and development data. Real data are regression checks only. Test seed generated after freeze.
limitations: One labelled positive recording and one labelled negative recording, one left-wrist Instinct user.
No real recording of the currently reported false-positive arm swings.
Old synthetic positive generator has no explicit flight/contact/shoulder-jump model.
New arm-swing trajectories are hypotheses; only rigid_arm_swing models stationary-shoulder rigid-arm kinematics.
PCA directions are not anatomical sources or world-vertical axes.
Original FIT timestamps are invalid; file order assumes 25 Hz.
No generated cohort is evidence of accuracy across real users.
